label: A-2 exploratory, post hoc (paired S_c1 difference, fixed receiver minus frozen; ho_02, ho_10, records 0-3)

side_unchanged_target.interpretation: S_c1 = net_wall / net_direct / r_dt. Where the wall side is unchanged, no factor has a systematic median shift: net_direct is 1.000 (the direct beam, direct gate and twin map are angle-symmetric about 0 deg, so the candidate-AoA sign flip leaves them untouched), and net_wall and r_dt each move by sub-percent in the median. The 3-6% figure reported in A12.3 is the median of the ABSOLUTE relative difference |dS|/|S|, i.e. a per-row spread, not a bias: the signed dS is symmetric about 0 (mean ~2e-4, median ~0, signs ~50/50), and a one-sample t-test does not reject zero mean (p~0.95 for both mapped methods). The per-row few-percent moves come from the receive AoA gate now sitting at +phi instead of -phi: its edges fall on slightly different cells of the (symmetric) measured wall-return point spread. CONCLUSION: consistent with gate-discretization noise, not a systematic shift; target S stays at ~1 so no genuine-target decision flips.
